versions.content: Handling different configuration variants at post-build time Type: valid Description: It shall be possible to have variation points in the ECU configuration which are bound at post-build time. Rationale: This will allow the existence of several ECU configuration variants in one ECU. Use Case: The same ECU software can be used for multiple ECUs which share the same application (e.g. left and right door modules) and the correct configuration for each one of them is chosen at runtime. Dependencies: – Supporting Material: AUTOSAR Glossary [5]
